key_insight: Dependency-aware greedy scheduling can exploit fine-grained parallelism across multi-core quantum systems to significantly reduce circuit makespan.
engineering_relevance: For multi-core quantum hardware, smarter gate scheduling can improve utilization and hide communication latency, making quantum execution more efficient.
method: Use a layered baseline where gates in the same layer run in parallel and layers run sequentially.
Apply a greedy scheduler that launches each gate as soon as dependencies and resources are available.
Exploit cross-core parallelism while respecting gate dependencies and resource constraints.
evidence_signal: On real benchmarks, the greedy strategy achieved an average 40% reduction in makespan and improved core utilization.
watch_item: Results depend on accurate dependency tracking and resource/communication modeling, which may be harder to implement on real hardware with variable latency.
paper_title: Dependency-Aware Circuit Scheduling for Multi-Core Quantum Systems to Minimize Makespan
